==About Voicelines==
{{VO
|character                   = Yuanwu
|language                    = en

<!-- Thoughts -->
|vo_01_01_title              = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx                 = Hello there. What will it be for today? Are you here to put in some extra work, or maybe just to loosen up a bit? Of couse, you're welcome for a chat, too. One moment, I'll go make some tea for you.

|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = Exercising is essential for us martial artists. Other people may not find the same importance in exercise, since everyone has their own unique strengths. After all, we no longer live in a time where brute force is the only solution. Or rather, brute force never really solved anything.

|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = Rumors have been circulating about me, and I don't intend to stop them. My story isn't particularly exciting, but people find amusement in talking about it, that doesn't bother me. And with words about me getting out there, I might end up reeling in a few dunderheads. Whatever impression others may have of me, I trust your judgment will not be swayed. Or, if I may say so, I am happy to accept whatever you think of me.

|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = I did hurt people in the past, sometimes with my hands, and sometimes through other means. Back then, I had to take the initiative... to make sure no more innocent people would fall prey to them. I had experience handling such things, and that was why I felt obligated to help. But I'm not telling you this in response to the rumors. I believe friendship is built on mutual understanding, and now is a good time for you to get to know me better.

|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = When it comes to the business world, one is often told that it's impossible to find true friendship. I have to concede, nobody I've ever known has understood me as well as you do. Though my gym has many customers, you are the only one to have become a true friend of mine. You are, and will always be welcome at my gym, my friend.


<!-- Miscellaneous -->
|vo_02_01_title              = Yuanwu's Hobby
|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = A steaming cup of tea makes an excellent remedy for sore muscles after an intense workout. It's quite effective, you should give it a try.

|vo_02_02_title              = Yuanwu's Trouble
|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = Nestled between the borders, {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou|Jinzhou|Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.}} is subject to ever-changing weather. Sustaining the dried fish I've been making for Mimi has been a difficult task... Hmm, I suppose a solution will come to me in due time.

|vo_02_03_title              = Favorite Food
|vo_02_03_file               = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg
|vo_02_03_tx                 = The solid ingredients of Jinzhou Stew blend effortlessly to form a simple dish. Back in the days when I had to live far away from home, it was the only dish that I could recreate to make me feel close to my roots. I can never have enough of it.

|vo_02_04_title              = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = I'm not a big fan of foods that are hard to chew… Oh, it's got nothing to do with my teeth. I'm just not fond of the prickling sensation of stickiness in my mouth.

|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = Well... I just want to maintain the stability I currently enjoy, and maybe keep my hometown safe, if I get the luxury to, haha.


<!-- Chat -->
|vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = Have I been keeping some kind of secret healthy drink in this flask, you ask? *chuckle* It's really just regular hot tea.

|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = The stiffest tree is often broken by the harshest of winds, whereas the bamboo and willow survive by bending along. Finding harmony between strength and adaptability is integral to lasting success, be it in martial arts, commerce, or all aspects of life.


<!-- About Others -->
|vo_04_01_title              = About [[Lingyang]]
|vo_04_01_intimacy           = 1
|vo_04_01_file               = {character}{language} About Lingyang.ogg
|vo_04_01_tx                 = Lingyang often visits my gym to play with Mimi just outside the front doors, always carrying a couple of fresh tetras as treats. I guess it might be his thank-you to Mimi for all the agility training they had done together. He sure is a thoughtful young man.
|vo_04_01_mention            = Lingyang

|vo_04_02_title              = About [[Jianxin]]
|vo_04_02_intimacy           = 2
|vo_04_02_file               = {character}{language} About Jianxin.ogg
|vo_04_02_tx                 = I am more than happy to get an outstanding training partner like Jianxin by merely offering her a simple meal... Of course, I'm always pleased to spend time with her over a meal, whether she's here to train with me or not.
|vo_04_02_mention            = Jianxin

|vo_04_03_title              = About [[Danjin]]
|vo_04_03_intimacy           = 3
|vo_04_03_file               = {character}{language} About Danjin.ogg
|vo_04_03_tx                 = I can sense a dangerous aura from Danjin's way of fighting... I'm worried that she may have far too much burden on her shoulders at such a young age.
|vo_04_03_mention            = Danjin

|vo_04_04_title              = About [[Chixia]]
|vo_04_04_intimacy           = 4
|vo_04_04_file               = {character}{language} About Chixia.ogg
|vo_04_04_tx                 = Every morning, when I opened the gym, Chixia was already patrolling the street with exuberant energy. *chuckle*... I must keep up with my exercises too. Can't be outdone by the younger generations.
|vo_04_04_mention            = Chixia

|vo_04_05_title              = About [[Rover]]
|vo_04_05_intimacy           = 5
|vo_04_05_file               = {character}{language} About Rover.ogg
|vo_04_05_tx                 = Your poise and comfidence are impressive. Such remarkable character can't possibly be built overnight. I can tell you've experienced far more than I have.
|vo_04_05_mention            = Rover


<!-- Birthday -->
|vo_05_01_title              = Birthday Wishes
|vo_05_01_file               = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg
|vo_05_01_tx                 = You're always tied up with affairs, how about relaxing a bit for a change on your birthday? Here, I got you an ordermade massager, some Angelica Tea leaves, and a personalized health management planner for the upcoming year. You really should prioritize your health. Self-care comes before anything else, including helping other people, my friend.


<!-- Idles -->
|vo_06_01_title              = Idle: I
|vo_06_01_file               = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg
|vo_06_01_tx                 = Oh? *chuckles*... Did you smell the dried fish I have?

|vo_06_02_title              = Idle: II
|vo_06_02_file               = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg
|vo_06_02_tx                 = *Effort Sound*

|vo_06_03_title              = Idle: III
|vo_06_03_file               = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg
|vo_06_03_tx                 = Please don't worry. I've got it in check.


<!-- Greetings -->
|vo_07_01_title              = Self-Introduction
|vo_07_01_file               = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg
|vo_07_01_tx                 = Hello. I am Yuanwu, and I run a boxing gym. It's not a big place, but we make sure every customer is treated with finesse. You're welcome to visit any time.

|vo_07_02_title              = Greeting
|vo_07_02_file               = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg
|vo_07_02_tx                 = Whether you need help with working out or maintaining your health, feel free to come by my gym. We welcome all visitors.


<!-- Join Team -->
|vo_08_01_title              = Join Team: I
|vo_08_01_file               = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg
|vo_08_01_tx                 = Ready to rumble.

|vo_08_02_title              = Join Team: II
|vo_08_02_file               = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg
|vo_08_02_tx                 = Anything I can help you with?

|vo_08_03_title              = Join Team: III
|vo_08_03_file               = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg
|vo_08_03_tx                 = It's nice to take a break once in a while.


<!-- Ascension -->
|vo_09_01_title              = Ascension: I
|vo_09_01_ascension          = 1
|vo_09_01_file               = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg
|vo_09_01_tx                 = I haven't felt this tingling sensation swimming across my veins in a while... So this is all your doing? *chuckle* Looks like this is going to take some time getting used to.

|vo_09_02_title              = Ascension: II
|vo_09_02_ascension          = 2
|vo_09_02_file               = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg
|vo_09_02_tx                 = Now that I've gotten used to it, this power feels robust and flexible. It does have something in common with my {{Extra Effect|Leihuangquan|Leihuangquan|A unique martial art practiced by Yuanwu, known for its heavy and fierce strikes. However, only those who temper their strength with precise control can wield it without breaking themselves.}}.

|vo_09_03_title              = Ascension: III
|vo_09_03_ascension          = 3
|vo_09_03_file               = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg
|vo_09_03_tx                 = Thanks to your help, my skills have improved and even my thunderbolts are stronger. Owing to your aid, I might be able to get a couple more scoundrels dealt with.

|vo_09_04_title              = Ascension: IV
|vo_09_04_ascension          = 4
|vo_09_04_file               = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg
|vo_09_04_tx                 = I can't thank you enough. With such power, I feel young and back to my prime days again. They say that time is invaluable. Doesn't that make the gift of power you've bestowed on me priceless? *chuckle*... Now, if you'd allow me some time, I should come up with a way to repay the favor.

|vo_09_05_title              = Ascension: V
|vo_09_05_ascension          = 5
|vo_09_05_file               = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg
|vo_09_05_tx                 = Since you've gifted me such a precious treasure, I should give you a matching gift in return. Please, take this Tea Pet—it grants you free access to all the boxing gyms and teahouses in {{Extra Effect|Huanglong|Huanglong|Located at the edge of the continent, this country borders the sea to the east. It boasts a vast territory with one capital and six major cities.}}. And... if you ever need me, just hand it to any one of the shopkeepers. I will come to your aid as soon as possible, no matter what.
}}
